correction: An early discussion and one v3 scope-limit sentence describe current return semantics as value-bearing. That is not an observed native behavior. The unchanged epoch-1 stream engine maps internal RETURN to no output envelope plus optional managed state. YIELD may carry a value including null. The standalone probe exercises only yield-style output turns; it does not execute or validate native RETURN.
design_disposition: ADR-0044 now distinguishes the current state-only RETURN wire from a proposed versioned OUTPUT(value)/NO_OUTPUT language profile. No old receipt reinterpretation or production change is authorized by the probe.
historical_evidence_policy: The original source-bound reports and review statements are retained unchanged. This clarification does not alter test results, frozen source hashes or the protocol-only verdict.
